hook: Microscopic DNA sails can pull molecules apart
what_happened: Researchers built DNA-based micro‑sails that generate forces to separate molecules
why_it_matters: It offers a new tool to study mechanical forces in biology and drug interactions
the_catch: The study was performed in vitro and the sails’ performance under physiological conditions remains untested
caption: Scientists have created tiny DNA sails that can pull molecules apart, opening new ways to study mechanical forces in biology. How could this help drug design? #gummietech
alt_text: A five‑slide carousel explaining that researchers built microscopic DNA sails to pull molecules apart and its potential impact on biology and drug design
